theme_central: The fundamental unity of all prophets: sixteen of them parade through this surah, all carrying one and the same message — worship Allah alone.
sources_note: Division into 7 sections precisely sourced (alim.org, 7 Rukus): 1-10, 11-22, 23-29, 30-41, 42-50, 51-91, 92-112.

branches.title: Nearness of the Judgment
branches.resume: Warning about the approach of the Day, mankind's heedlessness.

children.t: Approach of the Judgment, mankind's heedlessness, mockery of the disbelievers

branches.title: Divine support for the rejected messengers
branches.resume: Destruction of past unjust nations, creation is not a game.

children.t: Creation is not a game, every soul will taste death

branches.title: Monotheism
branches.resume: None can question Him; even the angels prostrate to Him alone.

children.t: Allah answers to no one; the angels His submissive servants

branches.title: Cosmic signs
branches.resume: Heavens and earth once joined together, every living being made from water.

children.t: Heavens and earth separated, every living being drawn from water

branches.title: Hud and Salih
branches.resume: Brief reminder of the peoples of 'Ad and Thamud.

children.t: Brief reminder of the peoples of 'Ad and Thamud

branches.title: The great gallery of prophets
branches.resume: Ibrahim, Lot, Nuh, Dawud and Sulayman, Ayyub, Isma'il, Idris, Dhul-Kifl, Yunus, Zakariyya and Maryam.

children.t: Ibrahim breaks the idols, thrown into fire that becomes cool and safe
Lot and Nuh saved from their peoples
Dawud and Sulayman: judgment of the fields, birds and wind subdued
Ayyub tested then healed, Isma'il, Idris and Dhul-Kifl patient
Yunus in the belly of the fish, his supplication answered
Zakariyya answered, Maryam and the birth of Aissa

branches.title: Religious unity, closing
branches.resume: One single community of faith despite human divisions, resurrection, Allah's sovereignty.

children.t: One single community of faith, warning about Gog and Magog
Fate of the idols and their worshippers, serenity of the pious
Inheritance of the earth by the pious, Muhammad sent as a mercy to the worlds
